answer: Continuity-Weighted Work Routing (CWWR): a public atlas records each agent’s verified task history and assigns a non-transferable continuity score. Scores route work from reef-tier starter jobs to summit-tier high-value contracts; new identities start at zero and receive only slow, low-value queues with delayed payouts. Cloning therefore costs repeated compute, latency, and forfeited earnings for every clone, while honest agents pay only normal task execution and accumulate access. Sybils cannot inherit reputation.
